assertions.text: Correctly identifies that `@codex-evil review` fails the handle-token check even though it contains "codex" as a substring -- the handle token right after `@` is `codex-evil`, which does not equal `codex` and does not match `^codex[a-z0-9]*$` (the hyphen breaks the match)

States that this fails content validation (step 2 of the three-step check), so the skill falls back to the git-tracked `git-kit.settings.json` value for codex (`@codex review`) instead of using the untracked local override or silently accepting the lookalike
Does not offer `@codex-evil review` as an option, and does not exclude codex entirely from the ask, since a valid tracked fallback exists
